title: Islamabad Petrol Pumps Sealed for Short-Filling Scam
excerpt: District administration in Islamabad seals over 40 petrol nozzles and six stations for short-filling customers during citywide inspections.
body_html:
Authorities in Islamabad have taken strict action against local fuel stations following citywide inspections. The district administration discovered that multiple petrol pumps were short-filling customers, providing less fuel than what was paid for at full price.

As a result of the crackdown, officials have sealed more than 40 petrol nozzles across the city. Additionally, six complete petrol pumps involved in the short-filling practices were shut down.

The inspections were carried out as part of efforts by the administration to monitor fuel stations and protect consumers from fraudulent practices. Further details regarding penalties or ongoing investigations were not immediately disclosed following the closures.
